description: Start one asynchronous Google Maps business search in one canonical location. This uses Pay on Find. First call check_account and find_locations, tell the user the maximum cost (up to 3 credits per business, capped by the available balance), and note that starting an enriched run requires at least 1 credit per requested business during a trial or 1.5 credits per requested business on a paid plan. obtain confirmation. Use one stable idempotency_key for retries.
